From iconic Swiss timepieces to stunning designer jewelry, our latest arrivals showcase the finest craftsmanship and timeless elegance that discerning collectors and enthusiasts seek. What's New This Week at Gray and SonsFeatured New Arrivals:Our master watchmakers and jewelry experts have meticulously restored three exceptional pieces that exemplify luxury and sophistication. Rolex Datejust 278341 - A Perfect Balance of Elegance and Precision The Rolex Datejust 278341 represents the pinnacle of luxury watches craftsmanship. This stunning 31mm timepiece features an 18k gold ring construction combined with stainless steel, creating the perfect two-tone aesthetic. The diamond-set bezel adds extraordinary brilliance, while the slate Roman numeral dial provides sophisticated readability. Priced at $15,550, this authentic watch comes with our comprehensive 24-month warranty and represents exceptional value in today's market for pre-owned Rolex timepieces. Corum $5 Coin Watch - Numismatic Excellence in Gold The Corum $5 Coin watch showcases the brand's innovative approach to horological design. Crafted in 18k yellow gold with a genuine $5 gold coin dial, this 24mm timepiece represents both monetary and artistic value at $4,000. The 14k gold watch features a diamond crown and quartz movement, making it both practical and collectible. This unique piece appeals to both gold watch collectors and numismatic enthusiasts. Bulgari Mother of Pearl and Onyx Pendant - Italian Luxury Redefined This exceptional Bvlgari pendant exemplifies high end jewelry design with its reversible mother of pearl and onyx construction. Set in 18k gold and stainless steel on a 15-inch black cord, this piece offers versatility and sophistication at $2,900. The pendant comes with its original Bulgari pouch, ensuring authenticity and proper presentation. Limited-Time Exceptional DealsToday's Top Picks on Sale:Patek Philippe Neptune 5080 - Swiss Excellence at Unprecedented Value The Patek Philippe Neptune 5080 represents an extraordinary opportunity for collectors seeking luxury watch brands at exceptional value. Originally priced at $25,890, this magnificent 36mm stainless steel timepiece with its distinctive salmon dial is now available for $19,500 - a savings of over $6,000. The graduated reeded bezel and large white gold applied hour markers demonstrate Patek Philippe's commitment to both functionality and aesthetic excellence. Natural Ruby Ring - Burmese Magnificence This remarkable Natural Ruby Ring features a 47.17 carat GemResearch Swisslab certified natural pinkish-red Burmese ruby. Reduced from $19,900 to $14,900 (originally $35,000 MSRP), this 18k white gold creation includes over one carat of black diamonds. The dramatic size and exceptional provenance make this piece a standout addition to any high end jewelry collection. Swiss Hunter Case Pocket Watch - Horological Heritage This exceptional Swiss made pocket watch represents the golden age of antique pocket watch craftsmanship. Featuring a 14k yellow gold hunter case and LeCoultre Ebauche movement with 29 jewels, this 52mm timepiece includes chronograph and quarter-hour repeater functions. Reduced from $6,500 to $5,990, it offers collectors an opportunity to own a piece of horological history.
